review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no simp lemmas or attributes, so I judged the simp interface only through the rewriting it relies on. I read the definitions of tailPolynomialThreshold and dyadicObservationWidth and grepped for repeats of the local rewrite facts. The `local irreducible` attributes and the other two theorems showed no simp problem. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim about how the simplifier behaves. I recommend one lemma plus a normal form, not blanket simp attributes.

findings.excerpt:
have hell : dyadicObservationWidth (r₀ i) (j i) = (u i)^(101/100:ℝ) := by
    unfold dyadicObservationWidth u
    norm_num
findings.problem: The proof rewrites two definitions by hand: `tailPolynomialThreshold … (j i).castSucc` becomes `(u i)^40`, and `dyadicObservationWidth` becomes `(u i)^(101/100)`. It builds these as local `have`s, `hpow` and `hell`, and feeds them to `simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc, hpow, hell]` four times. No library lemma gives these facts. The `dyadicObservationWidth` definition uses the literal `(1.01:ℝ)`, so every caller needs `unfold … ; norm_num` to reach the form `(…)^(101/100)` that downstream statements use. The same `hpow` and `hell` blocks, character for character, also appear in ActualBandInverseBarrier.lean and AnnularEventNumericsBarrier.lean. TailInitialEventuallyBarrier.lean has a separate lemma, `tailPolynomialThreshold_zero`, for the `j = 0` case only. Because no lemma states the unfolded form, any `simp` call on these terms must either unfold the definitions or be handed ad hoc hypotheses.
findings.proposed_change:
Next to the definitions, add two named lemmas and use them here.
1. An unconditional lemma `dyadicObservationWidth_eq : dyadicObservationWidth r k = ((2:ℝ)^k*r)^(101/100:ℝ)`, proved once by `unfold dyadicObservationWidth; norm_num`. It is a good `@[simp]` candidate because the right side contains no `dyadicObservationWidth`, so it cannot loop. Alternatively, change the definition to use `(101/100:ℝ)`.
2. A conditional lemma `tailPolynomialThreshold_castSucc_of_le (hr : 0 ≤ ((2:ℝ)^j.val*r)) (h1 : (2:ℝ)^j.val*r ≤ 1) : tailPolynomialThreshold r j.castSucc = ((2:ℝ)^j.val*r)^40`. Do not mark it `@[simp]`, because it carries hypotheses. Pass it by name to `simp only [...]` or `rw`.
Then replace `hpow` and `hell` with these lemmas, so the `simpa only` calls become `simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc, tailPolynomialThreshold_castSucc_of_le …, dyadicObservationWidth_eq]`. Delete the duplicate blocks in the two sibling files too.
findings.benefit: The three proofs stop repeating the same unfolding work. The normal form of `dyadicObservationWidth` becomes canonical for any `simp` user, and the castSucc evaluation of the threshold becomes a named, reusable rewrite. This also removes the dependence on `unfold … ; norm_num` producing exactly `101/100`.
